notes:
### New
- **Edit a track's info.** Click a selected track's title, artist, album, genre, label or year again to edit it right in the list (Enter saves, Esc cancels), or right-click a track → **Edit info…** to change its
  title, artist, album, genre, label, remixer, year or comment; select
  several tracks to change a field on all of them. It's written into the
  audio file, Engine DJ and Rekordbox (like Tidy's fixes, with backups you
  can undo from the Backups tab) and into OpenCrate's own library.
- **Export to a USB stick from OpenCrate's own library.** Sync → USB stick →
  Export to stick now takes the playlists, tags, cues, loops and beatgrids
  (including the ones you edited in OpenCrate) from OpenCrate, for Rekordbox
  and/or Engine DJ. Rekordbox's library is still available as the source.
- **Export to a completely fresh USB stick, also for Engine DJ.** A stick
  without an Engine DJ library now gets a new one when you export (before,
  Engine DJ had to set it up first). You can still let Engine DJ do that.
- **Engine DJ no longer re-analyses songs OpenCrate wrote.** OpenCrate now
  makes Engine's overview waveforms (the database entry and the coloured
  file Denon players draw) when it analyses a song (or when it writes the
  song to Engine DJ), and marks the song analysed, so a Denon player or
  Engine DJ doesn't analyse it again. Songs already in an Engine library or
  on a stick that lack one get it on the next sync or export (the preview
  says how many).
- **Progress with a percentage in the status bar** (analysis, writing tags,
  exporting to a stick) instead of a spinner.
- **Export shows progress while it makes Engine DJ waveforms** ("Engine DJ
  waveforms · 120 / 747"), and keeps each waveform in OpenCrate's library, so
  the next export to Engine DJ skips that work.
- **Choose the player preferences for an Engine DJ stick.** The export screen
  has a **Player preferences (Engine DJ)** menu: **Keep the stick's own** (the
  default, an export never changes them) or one of Engine DJ's profiles from
  this computer, which is put on the stick (the old file is backed up first).
- **A warning before exporting songs that aren't analysed yet.** The Preview
  lists them and has an **Analyse now** button. Export can also wait for the
  analysis by itself (Settings → Sync → Wait for analysis before exporting to
  a stick, on by default).

### Fixed
- A stick export to Engine DJ now also updates the title, artist, album,
  genre, label, remixer, year, comment and rating of songs already on the
  stick when you changed them on the computer. Before, only new songs were
  written, so an edit reached Rekordbox but not Engine DJ. The Preview says
  how many songs get updated.
